verses.original: בְּ֭נִי הַקְשִׁ֑יבָה לְחָכְמָתִ֣י הַט־ אָזְנֶֽךָ׃ לִ֝תְבוּנָתִ֗י
verses.transliteration: bə·nî haq·šî·ḇāh lə·ḥā·ḵə·mā·ṯî haṭ- ’ā·zə·ne·ḵā liṯ·ḇū·nā·ṯî
verses.literal: My son pay attention to my wisdom incline your ear to my insight

verses.original: לִשְׁמֹ֥ר מְזִמּ֑וֹת שְׂפָתֶ֥יךָ יִנְצֹֽרוּ׃ וְ֝דַ֗עַת
verses.transliteration: liš·mōr mə·zim·mō·wṯ śə·p̄ā·ṯe·ḵā yin·ṣō·rū wə·ḏa·‘aṯ
verses.literal: that you may maintain discretion and your lips may preserve knowledge

verses.original: כִּ֤י שִׂפְתֵ֣י זָרָ֑ה תִּ֭טֹּפְנָה נֹ֣פֶת חִכָּֽהּ׃ וְחָלָ֖ק מִשֶּׁ֣מֶן
verses.transliteration: kî śip̄·ṯê zā·rāh tiṭ·ṭō·p̄ə·nāh nō·p̄eṯ ḥik·kāh wə·ḥā·lāq miš·še·men
verses.literal: Though the lips of the forbidden woman drip honey and her speech [is] smoother than oil

verses.original: וְֽ֭אַחֲרִיתָהּ מָרָ֣ה כַֽלַּעֲנָ֑ה חַ֝דָּ֗ה פִּיּֽוֹת׃ כְּחֶ֣רֶב
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯāh mā·rāh ḵal·la·‘ă·nāh ḥad·dāh pî·yō·wṯ kə·ḥe·reḇ
verses.literal: in the end she is bitter as wormwood sharp as a double-edged sword

verses.original: רַ֭גְלֶיהָ יֹרְד֣וֹת מָ֑וֶת צְעָדֶ֥יהָ יִתְמֹֽכוּ׃ שְׁ֝א֗וֹל
verses.transliteration: raḡ·le·hā yō·rə·ḏō·wṯ mā·weṯ ṣə·‘ā·ḏe·hā yiṯ·mō·ḵū šə·ʾôl
verses.literal: Her feet go down to death her steps lead straight to Sheol

verses.original: פֶּן־ תְּפַלֵּ֑ס אֹ֣רַח חַ֭יִּים לֹ֣א תֵדָֽע׃פ מַ֝עְגְּלֹתֶ֗יהָ נָע֥וּ
verses.transliteration: pen- tə·p̄al·lês ’ō·raḥ ḥay·yîm lō ṯê·ḏā‘ ma‘·gə·lō·ṯe·hā nā·‘ū
verses.literal: She does not consider the path of life she does not know that her ways are unstable

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ־ לִ֑י וְאַל־ תָּ֝ס֗וּרוּ מֵאִמְרֵי־ פִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ḇā·nîm šim·‘ū- lî wə·’al- tā·sū·rū mê·’im·rê- p̄î
verses.literal: So now my sons listen to me and do not turn aside from the words of my mouth

verses.original: דַרְכֶּ֑ךָ הַרְחֵ֣ק מֵעָלֶ֣יהָ וְאַל־ תִּ֝קְרַ֗ב אֶל־ פֶּ֥תַח בֵּיתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ḏar·ke·ḵā har·ḥêq mê·‘ā·le·hā wə·’al- tiq·raḇ ’el- pe·ṯaḥ bê·ṯāh
verses.literal: Keep your path far from her do not go near . . . the door of her house

verses.original: פֶּן־ תִּתֵּ֣ן הוֹדֶ֑ךָ לַאֲחֵרִ֣ים וּ֝שְׁנֹתֶ֗יךָ לְאַכְזָרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: pen- tit·tên hō·w·ḏe·ḵā la·’ă·ḥê·rîm ū·šə·nō·ṯe·ḵā lə·’aḵ·zā·rî
verses.literal: lest you concede your vigor to others and your years to one who is cruel

verses.original: פֶּֽן־ זָרִ֣ים יִשְׂבְּע֣וּ כֹּחֶ֑ךָ וַ֝עֲצָבֶ֗יךָ בְּבֵ֣ית נָכְרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: pen- zā·rîm yiś·bə·‘ū kō·ḥe·ḵā wa·‘ă·ṣā·ḇe·ḵā bə·ḇêṯ nā·ḵə·rî
verses.literal: lest strangers feast on your wealth and your labors [enrich] the house of a foreigner

verses.original: בְאַחֲרִיתֶ֑ךָ וְנָהַמְתָּ֥ בְּ֝שָׂרְךָ֗ וּשְׁאֵרֶֽךָ׃ בִּכְל֥וֹת
verses.transliteration: ḇə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯe·ḵā wə·nā·ham·tā bə·śā·rə·ḵā ū·šə·’ê·re·ḵā biḵ·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: At the end of your life you will groan when your flesh and your body are spent

verses.original: וְֽאָמַרְתָּ֗ אֵ֭יךְ שָׂנֵ֣אתִי מוּסָ֑ר לִבִּֽי׃ נָאַ֥ץ וְ֝תוֹכַ֗חַת
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā ’êḵ śā·nê·ṯî mū·sār lib·bî nā·’aṣ wə·ṯō·w·ḵa·ḥaṯ
verses.literal: and you will say How I hated discipline and my heart despised reproof

verses.original: וְֽלֹא־ שָׁ֭מַעְתִּי בְּק֣וֹל מוֹרָ֑י לֹא־ הִטִּ֥יתִי אָזְנִֽי׃ וְ֝לִֽמְלַמְּדַ֗י
verses.transliteration: wə·lō·šā- šā·maʿ·tî bə·qō·wl mō·w·rāy lō- hiṭ·ṭî·ṯî ’ā·zə·nî wə·lim·lam·mə·ḏay
verses.literal: I did not listen to the voice of my teachers [or] incline my ear to my mentors

verses.original: הָיִ֣יתִי כִּ֭מְעַט בְכָל־ רָ֑ע בְּת֖וֹךְ קָהָ֣ל וְעֵדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hā·yî·ṯî kim·‘aṭ ḇə·ḵāl- rā‘ bə·ṯō·wḵ qā·hāl wə·‘ê·ḏāh
verses.literal: I am on the brink of utter ruin in the midst of the whole assembly . . .

verses.original: שְׁתֵה־ מַ֥יִם מִבּוֹרֶ֑ךָ וְ֝נֹזְלִ֗ים מִתּ֥וֹךְ בְּאֵרֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ṯêh- ma·yim mib·bō·w·re·ḵā wə·nō·zə·lîm mit·tō·wḵ bə·’ê·re·ḵā
verses.literal: Drink water from your own cistern and running water from your own well

verses.original: מַעְיְנֹתֶ֣יךָ יָפ֣וּצוּ ח֑וּצָה פַּלְגֵי־ מָֽיִם׃ בָּ֝רְחֹב֗וֹת
verses.transliteration: ma‘·yə·nō·ṯe·ḵā yā·p̄ū·ṣū ḥū·ṣāh pal·ḡê- mā·yim bā·rə·ḥō·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: Why should your springs flow in the streets your streams of water in the public squares

verses.original: יִֽהְיוּ־ לְךָ֥ לְבַדֶּ֑ךָ וְאֵ֖ין אִתָּֽךְ׃ לְזָרִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: yih·yū- lə·ḵā lə·ḇad·de·ḵā wə·’ên ’it·tāḵ lə·zā·rîm
verses.literal: Let them be yours alone never to be shared with strangers

verses.original: מְקוֹרְךָ֥ יְהִֽי־ בָר֑וּךְ וּ֝שְׂמַ֗ח מֵאֵ֥שֶׁת נְעוּרֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: mə·qō·wr·ḵā yə·hî- ḇā·rūḵ ū·śə·maḥ mê·’ê·šeṯ nə·‘ū·re·ḵā
verses.literal: May your fountain be blessed and may you rejoice in the wife of your youth

verses.original: אֲהָבִ֗ים אַיֶּ֥לֶת חֵ֥ן וְֽיַעֲלַ֫ת־ דַּ֭דֶּיהָ יְרַוֻּ֣ךָ בְכָל־ עֵ֑ת תִּשְׁגֶּ֥ה בְּ֝אַהֲבָתָ֗הּ תָמִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·hā·ḇîm ’ay·ye·leṯ ḥên wə·ya·‘ă·laṯ- dad·de·hā yə·raw·wu·ḵā ḇə·ḵāl- ‘êṯ tiš·geh bə·’a·hă·ḇā·ṯāh ṯā·mîḏ
verses.literal: A loving doe a graceful fawn may her breasts satisfy you always . . . may you be captivated by her love forever

verses.original: וְלָ֤מָּה תִשְׁגֶּ֣ה בְנִ֣י בְזָרָ֑ה וּ֝תְחַבֵּ֗ק חֵ֣ק נָכְרִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lām·māh ṯiš·geh ḇə·nî ḇə·zā·rāh ū·ṯə·ḥab·bêq ḥêq nā·ḵə·rî·yāh
verses.literal: Why be captivated my son by an adulteress or embrace the bosom of a stranger

verses.original: כִּ֤י אִ֑ישׁ דַּרְכֵי־ נֹ֨כַח׀ עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה מְפַלֵּֽס׃ וְֽכָל־ מַעְגְּלֹתָ֥יו
verses.transliteration: kî ’îš dar·ḵê- nō·ḵaḥ ‘ê·nê Yah·weh mə·p̄al·lês wə·ḵāl ma‘·gə·lō·ṯāw
verses.literal: For a man’s ways are before the eyes of the LORD and [the LORD] examines all his paths

verses.original: עַֽווֹנוֹתָ֗יו הָרָשָׁ֑ע יִלְכְּדֻנ֥וֹ אֶת־ יִתָּמֵֽךְ׃ חַ֝טָּאת֗וֹ וּבְחַבְלֵ֥י
verses.transliteration: ʿa·wō·nō·ṯå̄w hā·rā·šā‘ yil·kə·ḏu·nōw ’eṯ- yit·tā·mêḵ ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw ū·ḇə·ḥaḇ·lê
verses.literal: The iniquities of a wicked man entrap him - the cords of his sin entangle him

verses.original: ה֗וּא יָ֭מוּת בְּאֵ֣ין מוּסָ֑ר יִשְׁגֶּֽה׃פ וּבְרֹ֖ב אִוַּלְתּ֣וֹ
verses.transliteration: hū yā·mūṯ bə·’ên mū·sār yiš·geh ū·ḇə·rōḇ ’iw·wal·tōw
verses.literal: He dies for lack of discipline led astray by his own great folly
